notes: Scans and GNSS, the new look part 2b: the Scan view gets a start card, a floating view bar, class toggles, section strips, tilt fix, measuring and exports (PLY/PTS/PCD/E57, ortho GeoTIFF, DWG, Word/Excel reports). GNSS ▸ Process walks a job from RINEX to report on one page. Updates are now checked at every start and every 6 hours, so a release reaches you the same day. Fixed: coming back from a scan or the 3-D view no longer paints the drawing tools over the ribbon; the GNSS Calibration report button works.
